frontend_parity: Single-page Senate/House navigation; explicit live 2026 and historical selections, with no automatic historical substitution for a missing live forecast.
435-district current map, dynamic ranked ribbon above map, qualified chamber-control graphic below map, and selected district details synchronized with map and race list.
Show only safe, likely and tossup categories; heading uses qualified projected-control color, purple for tossup.
Model builder initially collapsed with the reviewed default selected; show all eight conceptual roles, implemented availability and supported option combinations separately.
Exact saved configurations, browser history, share links and matched comparisons preserve configuration, run, cutoff, geography and artifact identity.
First 10 races with an expand control; independently usable focus sidebar and keyboard/mobile interactions.
Explain source inclusion, assumptions and terms in plain language; separate successful computation, experimental status, testing evidence and publication qualification.
Historical accuracy remains accessible; the current 2026 view cannot display observed 2026 winners or invented historical scores.
native_packet_requirements: Versioned manifest and reviewed source/audit receipts; exact configuration identities, artifact hashes, default, supported and unsupported combinations, and intended publication scope.
All 435 unique district identities with cycle 2026, explicit mapVintage and exact geometry/source evidence; retain candidate/group target, roster source/cutoff and electoral-rule semantics.

Candidate and group outcomes must remain distinct. Preserve independent/other/unopposed/ranked-choice/runoff support; do not force every district into two D/R candidate rows. Gonzales TX-23 excluded from current roster per backend owner.
Actual issued/forecast/source cutoff timestamps, poll counts/inclusion explanations, assumptions and qualifications; never infer strict original-vintage availability from a retrieval timestamp.

Joint draw identity, configuration, source digest, draw count and complete ordered district set. For qualified control, coherent D/R/unresolved seat PMFs, 435 total seats, threshold 218 and zero retained seats, plus precision evidence.
Tipping requires its explicit statistic and per-district frequencies calculated from the same joint uncertainty. Per-race probabilities alone do not qualify control or tipping.
Provide party/caucus aggregation explicitly where independent or pooled outcomes exist. No frontend allocation of pooled probability to named candidates.
Share outputs must name their denominator and preserve uncertainty. Scores need exact earlier-election model/configuration/cutoff bindings; current results have no observed outcomes.
